parsed.claim_reason: Choose a member E; pairwise intersection makes E a finite transversal. Induct on |E|. Every minimal transversal T meets E. For e in T∩E, T\{e} is a minimal transversal of the subfamily whose members omit e, and E\{e} transverses that subfamily. Induction and finite union give finiteness.
parsed.witness_reason: The singleton sets F_n are pairwise disjoint, not pairwise intersecting. Moreover, {x_k} fails to meet F_n whenever n≠k, so it is not a transversal.
